caption: The drawing is on a rectangular, slightly yellowed or beige background, and consists primarily of black ink markings with symmetrical and geometric arrangements. In the center, there is a large square divided into a grid with various sections containing different geometric figures: there are numerous small black and white triangles arranged in alternating patterns, a pair of black-and-white circles, squares containing diagonal lines forming triangular shapes, and a pair of larger numbers ("9" and "5") in boxes. Several areas within the central square contain handwritten cursive script. Around the main central square, along all four edges, are rows of symbols—some linear arrays resembling crossed lines or pickets, others more ornate with curly or branch-like extensions. The upper right corner of the page contains a large, solid black triangle, stretching to the square's borders. At the bottom left, outside the main square, there is a rectangular brick pattern with several upright poles extending from it, and lines drawn to nearby structures, one with a plant- or tree-like motif. Additional handwritten labeling and script appear throughout the drawing. The overall composition is highly symmetrical and densely filled with visual elements, featuring a strictly monochrome palette (black ink on a light background).
title: Shaker Visionary Image
